restrictions: Only scalar mutable-reference acquisitions and unlabelled, non-package resolutions use the new transfer IR.
Historical/labelled endpoints, package scripts, non-scalar targets and call/loop summaries retain the qualified encoder.
Immutable value witnesses span a single representation transfer, not a whole loan lifetime.
Unresolved prophecy facts, persistent loan identities, reference-containing replacement, selected-element rules and compositional summaries remain R2 work.
Existing generic representation-caster contracts remain trusted; these checks do not establish their semantic soundness.
Seventeen expected unsupported client outcomes remain restrictions, not feature support.
The 790-client/2198-check restoration matrix and difficult H1 prefix proof are not qualified by this gate.

setup_failures.cause: Rust API reference/value type mismatch; fixed before native verification.
Non-Copy type required cloning; fixed before native verification.
Runner passed a new configuration flag to the old compiler, which correctly rejected it. Repeated in focused-baseline-02 with that flag omitted; not a proof failure.
